meanings.usage: 指治疗和护理病人的机构
指恶劣的天气现象，通常伴有大风大雨
指海中的大石头或礁石
指海洋、湖泊或河流的岸边
距离单位，1英里约等于1.6公里
指陡峭的山崖或海岸边的岩壁
指付出很大努力去做某事
指发出的光，可用于指引方向
指用言语阐述某事的原因或经过
指在前方或朝向未来的方向
指在脑海中回忆起过去的事情

meanings.meaning: in the darkness:在没有光线的情况下

examples.en: She set out from the coast in a small boat.
examples.zh: 她乘小船从海岸出发了。

examples.en: She was caught in a storm.
Towards evening, the boat struck a rock.
examples.zh: 临近傍晚时，小船撞上了一块礁石。

examples.en: The girl jumped into the sea.
She spent the whole night in the water.
She knew she was near the shore.
examples.zh: 她知道自己靠近海岸了。

phrases.usage: 表示一到达就...（相当于as soon as she arrived）

examples.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff.
examples.zh: 一到达海岸，女孩就艰难地向上爬向悬崖。

examples.en: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
examples.zh: 当她一天后醒来时，她发现自己在医院里。

examples.en: The girl struggled up the cliff towards the light.
examples.zh: 女孩艰难地向悬崖上的灯光爬去。

examples.en: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
examples.zh: 在那段时间里，她游了八英里。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻或某一段时间正在进行的动作 用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与when、while等连用

examples.en: One afternoon she set out from the coast.
examples.zh: 一天下午她从海岸出发了。

examples.en: The boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea.
examples.zh: 小船撞上了一块礁石，女孩跳入了海中。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句 (Time Clause with 'before')
grammar.structure: 主句 + before + 从句 / Before + 从句 + 主句
grammar.definition: 用before引导的时间状语从句，表示主句动作发生在从句动作之前 用于描述先后发生的两个动作，强调主句动作在从句动作之前

examples.en: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened.
examples.zh: 将近一周后，女孩才能解释发生了什么事。

examples.en: She found herself in hospital when she woke up a day later.
examples.zh: 当她一天后醒来时，她发现自己在医院里。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作 用于描述过去的过去，常与before、when等连用

examples.en: She explained what had happened to her.
examples.zh: 她解释了她所发生的事情。

patterns.pattern: ...before + 主语 + was able to do something

original.en: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened.
original.zh: 将近一周后，女孩才能解释发生了什么事。

imitations.en: Three hours passed before I was able to find my way.
imitations.zh: 三个小时后我才能找到路。

imitations.en: A long time passed before he was able to speak again.
imitations.zh: 很长时间后他才能再次说话。

original.en: The girl was swimming when the boat struck a rock.
original.zh: 当小船撞上礁石时，女孩正在游泳。

imitations.en: He was reading when the phone rang.
imitations.zh: 电话响的时候他正在看书。

imitations.en: They were walking along the beach when it started to rain.
imitations.zh: 开始下雨时他们正沿着海滩走。

patterns.pattern: On + 动词-ing, 主语 + 谓语

original.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff.
original.zh: 一到达海岸，女孩就艰难地向上爬向悬崖。

imitations.en: On hearing the news, she started to cry.
imitations.zh: 一听到这个消息，她就哭了起来。

imitations.en: On entering the room, he saw a stranger.
imitations.zh: 一进入房间，他就看到一个陌生人。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + spent + 时间 + in + 动词-ing

original.en: She spent the whole night in the water.

imitations.en: He spent two hours in waiting for the bus.
imitations.zh: 他等了两个小时公交车。

imitations.en: They spent the whole day in exploring the city.
imitations.zh: 他们花了一整天探索这座城市。

lines.en: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
lines.zh: 几乎过了一个星期，那姑娘才能讲述自己的遭遇。

lines.en: One afternoon she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm.
lines.zh: 一天下午，她乘小船从海岸出发，遇上了风暴。

lines.en: Towards evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea.
lines.zh: 天将黑时，小船撞在了一块礁石上，姑娘跳进了海里。

lines.en: Then she swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
lines.zh: 她在海里游了整整一夜才游到岸边。

lines.en: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.
lines.zh: 在那段时间里，她游了8英里。

lines.en: Early next morning, she saw a light ahead. She knew she was near the shore because the light was high up on the cliffs .
lines.zh: 第二天凌晨，她看到前方有灯光，知道自己已经接近岸边了，因为那灯光是在高高的峭壁上。

lines.en: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
lines.zh: 到达岸边后，姑娘朝着她看到的灯光方向挣扎着往峭壁上爬去。

lines.en: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
lines.zh: 第二天她醒来时，发现自己躺在医院里。

questions.q: Why was the girl in hospital?
questions.zh: 那个姑娘为什么会在医院里？
questions.a: Because her boat struck a rock and she jumped into the sea; after swimming all night and struggling up the cliff towards the light, she collapsed and was taken to hospital.
questions.aZh: 因为小船撞上礁石后她跳进海里，在水中游了整整一夜，最后挣扎着爬上峭壁就昏了过去，被人送进了医院。
questions.hint: 答案出自课文第 3 句与最后两句。

questions.q: Where did the girl set out from, and what happened to her on the way?
questions.zh: 姑娘从哪里出发？途中遇到了什么事？
questions.a: She set out from the coast in a small boat, was caught in a storm, and towards evening the boat struck a rock, so she jumped into the sea.
questions.aZh: 她乘小船从海岸出发，途中遇上风暴；天将黑时小船撞上一块礁石，她便跳进了海里。

questions.q: How far did the girl swim, and how did she know she was near the shore?
questions.zh: 姑娘游了多远？她怎么知道自己已接近岸边？
questions.a: She covered a distance of eight miles. Early next morning she saw a light ahead, high up on the cliffs, so she knew she was near the shore.
questions.aZh: 她游了八英里。第二天凌晨她看见前方有灯光，而且灯光高高地挂在峭壁上。

questions.q: What did the girl do on arriving at the shore?
questions.zh: 到达岸边后，姑娘做了什么？
questions.a: On arriving at the shore, she struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
questions.aZh: 一到岸边，她就朝着先前看到的那束灯光，挣扎着往峭壁上爬去。

questions.q: What do you think the title 'Out of the darkness' means?
questions.zh: 你认为标题“冲出黑暗”有什么含义？
questions.a: It refers both to the girl's escape from the dark sea at night and to her recovery from unconsciousness into light and safety.
questions.aZh: 它既指姑娘从夜里漆黑的海面上挣扎脱身，也指她从昏迷与无助中走出，重新回到灯光与安全之中。
questions.hint: 结合第 6 句峭壁上的灯光与结尾醒来躺在医院。

translation:
几乎过了一个星期，那姑娘才能讲述自己的遭遇。
一天下午，她乘小船从海岸出发，遇上了风暴。
天将黑时，小船撞在了一块礁石上，姑娘跳进了海里。
她在海里游了整整一夜才游到岸边。
在那段时间里，她游了8英里。
第二天凌晨，她看到前方有灯光，知道自己已经接近岸边了，因为那灯光是在高高的峭壁上。
到达岸边后，姑娘朝着她看到的灯光方向挣扎着往峭壁上爬去。
她所记得的就是这些。
第二天她醒来时，发现自己躺在医院里。
title: Out of the darkness
subtitle: 冲出黑暗

lead.question: 一个姑娘在海上搏斗一夜游了八英里，醒来时为何躺在医院里？
lead.warmup: 一个姑娘独自驾小船出海，却遇上风暴，船撞礁石后她跳进海里，在黑暗冰冷的海水中整整游了一夜，行程八英里。天亮前她看见峭壁高处的一点灯光，奋力挣扎爬上悬崖，随后失去知觉，醒来时已躺在医院里。本课带你弄清她为何近一周后才能讲述遭遇，并掌握 set out、be caught in、on arriving 等表达。
goals: 理解 before 引导时间状语从句时“过了……才”的译法，以及 explain 后接宾语从句的结构
掌握 set out from、be caught in、on arriving at、cover a distance of 等本课核心短语
区分表示方向与位置的介词 to / towards / from / off / up / into 等小品词
能用一般过去时与过去完成时复述这次海上脱险的经过
lead.summary: 故事按时间顺序推进：出海遇风暴→船撞礁石跳海→游了一夜共八英里→望见峭壁高处灯光→挣扎爬上悬崖→醒来已在医院。叙述以一般过去时为主，用过去完成时交代更早发生的事。语言重点：before 译作“过了……才”、be caught in 表“遭遇”、on + 动名词表“一……就”，以及 towards 强调“越来越近”的方向感。
lead.tips: 易错提醒：on arriving at the shore 中的 on 后必须接动名词；in hospital 表“住院（就医）”不加 the，加了 the 就变成“在那家医院里”。

exercises.q: 汉译英：几乎过了一个星期，那姑娘才能讲述自己的遭遇。
exercises.a: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.

exercises.q: 句型转换：用“on + 动名词”改写：As soon as she arrived at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
exercises.a: On arriving at the shore, the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
exercises.note: on+doing 相当于 as soon as/when。

exercises.q: 填空：One afternoon she set out ____ the coast in a small boat and was caught ____ a storm.
exercises.note: set out from 从…出发；be caught in 遭遇。

exercises.q: 改错：Then she swam to the shore after spend the whole night in the water.
exercises.a: Then she swam to the shore after spending the whole night in the water.
exercises.note: 介词 after 后须接动名词。

exercises.q: 改错：When she woke up a day later, she found herself in the hospital.
exercises.a: When she woke up a day later, she found herself in hospital.
exercises.note: in hospital 表“住院”，不加 the。

exercises.q: 选词填空（towards / into / to / ahead）：____ evening, the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped ____ the sea; then she swam ____ the shore and saw a light ____.
exercises.note: towards 表接近；ahead 副词置名词后。

exercises.q: 汉译英：在那段时间里，她游了8英里。
exercises.a: During that time she covered a distance of eight miles.

quiz.q: “她乘小船从海岸出发”的正确英文是？
options: She set out from the coast in a small boat.
She set out to the coast in a small boat.
She set out off the coast in a small boat.
She set out at the coast in a small boat.
quiz.note: set out from 表示“从……出发”。

options: was caught by a storm
was caught in a storm
caught a storm
was catching in a storm
quiz.note: be caught in 表突然遭遇风雨。

quiz.q: “天将黑时”在课文中是哪一项？
options: At evening
Towards evening
In evening
On evening

quiz.q: “几乎过了一个星期，那姑娘才能讲述自己的遭遇”应译为？
options: Nearly a week passed before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
Nearly a week passed after the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
Nearly a week passed when the girl was able to explain what had happened to her.
Nearly a week passed until the girl could explain what has happened to her.

quiz.q: “她朝着看到的灯光挣扎着爬上峭壁”是哪一句？
options: She struggled up the cliff towards the light she had seen.
She struggled down the cliff towards the light she had seen.
She struggled for the cliff towards the light she had seen.
She struggled off the cliff towards the light she had seen.
quiz.note: up 作介词，表“沿着……往上”。

quiz.q: 标题 Out of the darkness 中的 darkness 指的是什么？
options: the darkness of the sea at night
the darkness of the hospital
the darkness of the cliff
the darkness of the small boat
quiz.note: 指海上长夜的黑暗与昏迷的困境。
